Dates.text: Zarya, the first module of the station, launches.
Space Shuttle Endeavour launches with Unity, the first US module.
The first crew arrives; humans have lived aboard ever since.

Title: ISS construction begins
Body-Text: Approved in 1984, the space station was designed with partners from Canada, Japan and Europe, and Russia joined in 1993. In 1998 its first modules were launched. Today five space agencies operate the International Space Station, each managing the hardware it provides.
